title: Protocol Banks
tagline: Enterprise bulk payment and supplier management system - Supplier Wallet Tagging Management System
description: Enterprise-grade crypto payment infrastructure for modern businesses. Manage batch payments, track expenses, and visualize your financial network with precision.  Each supplier can be tagged in detail, managed through a tree diagram, and supported for financial data analysis, simply by connecting a non-custodial wallet.
how_its_made:
Supports the base chain, supports EIP3009 micro-payment, and uses the X402 gateway for payment. Payment options support Ethereum, L2, as well as mainstream networks such as Solana and Bitcoin. Since the development time was less than three days, we will also need to integrate multi-signature and enterprise-level hardware wallets later.
Two key innovations are included: users can create their own payment links by filling in their address and the amount, generating an X402 link. Additionally, CCTP has been integrated to enhance the USDC payment experience.
